editor.workflow: Open WBP_UIRoot Designer and select Interface screen / Language: Menu, Gameplay HUD, Settings, TEAM, Wardrobe and Boosters Shop are available. Settings has five preview tabs. Selections are isolated to the Designer session; current saved root has 121 widgets.

usage: Open /Game/Gameplay/UI/V2/WBP_UIUniversalPreview in the UMG Designer. Use the existing Gameplay UI Preview controls and Current UI/New UI buttons.
Use PreviewCulture and PreviewScenario, plus Designer Screen Size/DPI; preview selections do not change player settings.
Place WBP_UIUniversal in a parent layout. Choose Panel/Button/Progress and edit the Universal properties. Use the Content named slot for custom UMG children.
The parent screen owns anchors/alignment. The universal component does not replace its parent geometry; the specimen uses SafeZone, stretched anchors and scrolling.
Use a stable LabelKey and the shared localization table. Dynamic values remain in the existing presenters, formatted through MCUIDataLibrary.
WBP_UIRoot owns the screen switcher. Edit saved UMG children/anchors and Universal contour points. ToolIconArt contains tools only; perk artwork comes from DT_Perks.Icon.
Settings/TEAM text uses adaptive container sizing and wrapping at the intended font size. Test long localized strings with screen/DPI changes; do not resolve overflow through font shrink or ellipsis.

layoutPolicy.source: Explicit user adaptive-layout requirement during Settings/TEAM review.
layoutPolicy.requirement: Fit containers, spacing and layout to actual localized text. Preserve the intended font size; do not shrink text or hide it with ellipsis to force it into a fixed box.
layoutPolicy.implementationContract: Use desired-size measurement, wrapping, flexible rows/columns and available-width-aware layout; use scrolling where content cannot fit the viewport. Preserve correct anchors, SafeZone and separation between adjacent controls.
layoutPolicy.scopeLimit: Historical HUD screenshots from 2026-11-03 used bounded text/ellipsis. They do not demonstrate acceptance of the new requirement across all screens; remaining HUD/screens need review under this policy.
